basis: The dashboard provides explicit numeric market_share values as printed data labels above each bar. According to these labels, Edge has a market_share of 87%, Firefox has 23%, and Chrome has 5%. The task requires selecting the browser with the highest current market_share. Comparing the values, 87% (Edge) is the highest. Although the visual height of the Firefox bar appears slightly taller than the Edge bar, the explicit data labels are the authoritative source for the specific market_share values in this context, and they clearly indicate Edge has the largest share. Therefore, Edge is the browser to be assigned.
option_label: Assign Edge to the priority compatibility-testing queue
